content.short: Paybis Wallet is a crypto access product tied to Paybis buying, selling, swap, and on-ramp services.
content.description: Payba crypto buying and selling service with wallet and payment access around its exchange flow. Its site emphasizes card purchases, swaps, on/off-ramp support, and service coverage across many countries. The TON relevance is fiat-to-crypto access and custody-adjacent wallet use rather than a TON-native protocol. Buy Bitcoin with Credit Card or Debit Card instantly. Best Price in the world, 24/7 customer service, serving 48 U.S. Paybis Wallet is listed for account access and custody workflows rather than for running a protocol market.
